locations.description: Absolute paths of the folders to scan

minSize.description: Files smaller than this many bytes are left out; at least 1 (default 1)

digest.description: The digest of one of the scan's duplicate sets (UNKNOWN_SET otherwise)

keep.description: An absolute path inside the scan's roots that is a link of that set (PATH_NOT_IN_SET otherwise)
An absolute folder (or file) inside the scan's roots whose copies are kept

quarantineIn.description: An absolute folder inside the scan's roots whose copies are quarantined; neither equal to keep nor under it (INVALID_RULE)

rules.description: Applied in order; an operation's or conflict's ruleIndex is the position here, from 0

exceptions.description: Absolute files or folders inside the scan's roots that no rule quarantines a copy at or under

picks.description: At most one per digest (DUPLICATE_PICK); a pick overrides the rules for its set

ruleIndex.description: The rule's position in the request, from 0

folder.description: The rule's quarantineIn, normalized (Path.toString(): backslashes on Windows)

files.description: Scanned files left at or under folder after the plan

planId.description: The core's content-derived plan ID (64 lowercase hex characters): the same request on the same scan previews to the same ID

leftBehind.description: One entry per rule, in rule order

operationCount.description: Every quarantine operation of the plan

conflictCount.description: Every conflict of the plan; a plan with conflicts cannot be confirmed (U7.1)

files.description: Links moved: every link of every quarantined copy

bytes.description: Bytes freed: each quarantined copy's size once, whatever its link count

folder.description: The folder's path as the scan holds it (Path.toString(): backslashes on Windows)

totalFiles.description: Counted files in the whole subtree

filesWithCopyElsewhere.description: Files in the subtree with a different physical copy of their content outside the subtree; each file counts once

internalDuplicateFiles.description: For each content with k >= 2 physical copies inside the subtree, k - 1

internalBytes.description: For each such content, (k - 1) x size

folder.description: The summary of the folder given as under; null without under

items.description: Ordered by bytesWithCopyElsewhere, then internalBytes, largest first, then folder path

size.description: The page size asked for, 1 to 500

links.description: At least one; ordered by path

digest.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the content; identifies the set

size.description: Size of each file in bytes

reclaimableBytes.description: size * (physical copies - 1): hard links are not reclaimable copies

copies.description: At least two; ordered by first link path

path.description: The path as the scan holds it (Path.toString(): backslashes on Windows)

modified.description: The file's modified time at scan time

items.description: Ordered by reclaimableBytes, then size, largest first, then digest

size.description: The page size asked for, 1 to 500

totalReclaimableBytes.description: The reclaimable bytes of every matching set

items.description: Ordered by size, largest first, then digest, then first link

size.description: The page size asked for, 1 to 500
The set's file size in bytes

links.description: Every link of the quarantined copy (hard links move together), at least one, ordered by path

keeper.description: The first link (by path) of the copy this one is kept against; never one of links

ruleIndex.description: For kind rule: the rule's position in the request, from 0; else null

digest.description: For kind pick: the picked set's digest; else null

links.description: Every link of the copy (hard links are one copy), at least one, ordered by path

quarantinedBy.description: Ascending indexes of the conflict's rules that would quarantine this copy: every link under the rule's quarantineIn, none under its keep, none at or under an exception

keptBy.description: Ascending indexes of the conflict's rules that keep this copy as their keeper: of the copies with a link under the rule's keep, the one whose first link comes first by path

items.description: Ordered by size, largest first, then digest

size.description: The page size asked for, 1 to 500
The set's file size in bytes

copies.description: Every physical copy of the set, ordered by first link

sources.description: Every rule that would have produced an operation in this set, by ascending ruleIndex

a.description: The side whose folder sorts first

b.description: The side whose folder sorts second

items.description: Ordered by the larger bytesWithCopy of the two sides, largest first, then a's folder, then b's folder

size.description: The page size asked for, 1 to 500

folder.description: This side's folder (Path.toString(): backslashes on Windows)

filesWithCopy.description: Its files with a different physical copy of their content in the other folder; hard links never count

full.description: True exactly when this side has at least one file and every one of them has a copy in the other folder

path.description: The folder's path as the scan holds it (Path.toString(): backslashes on Windows)

name.description: The last name element; for a filesystem root such as C:\ the whole path

files.description: Counted files in the whole subtree

directFiles.description: Counted files directly in this folder

hasChildren.description: Whether listFolders with this folder as parent answers at least one folder
